items.title: 20.4 Orientation in Electrophilic Substitution Reactions (naya group kis position par lagega) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 20.4 with Quick Check 20.7 answered, printed pages 65-66.

blocks.text: Benzene ring par laga hua koi bhi group electrophilic substitution par asar dalta hai aur tay karta hai ke naya group kis position par lagega (orientation). Alag alag substituents aane wale electrophile ko do tareeqon se “raasta dikhate” (direct karte) hain.
Ortho-Para Directing Groups (Activating Groups: ring ko zyada reactive banane wale)

Jo group ring ko benzene se zyada reactive banaye aur aane wale electrophile ko sirf ortho aur para positions par lagaye, use ortho-para director kehte hain. Aise substituents “ortho” (1,2) ya “para” (1,4) product dete hain, aur para thora zyada banta hai. Is mein ortho aur para products zyada bante hain aur meta product bohat hi kam. Ortho-para directors ki misalein: -SR, -R, -OH, -OR, -NR₂, -SH. Yeh sab woh groups hain jo benzene ring ko electrons de sakte hain.

Methyl benzene ke ring ki chlorination aluminium chloride (bromine ke liye aluminium bromide) ya iron ki presence (mojoodgi) mein aur UV roshni ke baghair hoti hai. Yeh reactions room temperature par hoti hain. Methyl group 2,4-directing (o-p directing) hai, yani naya group zyada tar ring ki position 2 ya 4 par jata hai. Chlorine se 2-chloromethylbenzene aur 4-chloromethylbenzene ka mixture banta hai.

blocks.alt: 2 methylbenzene + 2Cl2, arrow ke oopar AlCl3 aur neeche anhydrous (pani ke baghair), se 2-chloromethylbenzene + 4-chloromethylbenzene + 2HCl. CH3 group highlighted hai, is note ke saath: electron dene wala (electron-donating) alkyl group jo 2 aur 4 positions ko activate (zyada reactive) karta hai.
blocks.caption: Methylbenzene ki chlorination (kitab ke PDF page 69 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki equation mein ek methylbenzene + 2Cl₂ se dono products + 2HCl likhe hain, jo balanced nahi: ek molecule se ek hi product banta hai. Sahi: 2 methylbenzene + 2Cl₂ → 2-chloromethylbenzene + 4-chloromethylbenzene + 2HCl (ya har molecule ke liye: C₆H₅CH₃ + Cl₂ → ClC₆H₄CH₃ + HCl).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: CH₃ ring ko electrons deta hai, is liye ring zyada reactive ho jati hai aur Cl zyada tar position 2 (ortho) aur 4 (para) par lagta hai.
Bromine se isi tarah ke bromine compounds bante hain. Methyl group ki tarah OH group bhi ring ko active karta hai, is liye naye groups zyada tar positions 2, 4 aur 6 par jate hain.
Meta Directing (Deactivating) Groups (ring ko kam reactive banane wale)

Jo group ring ko benzene se kam reactive banaye aur aane wale electrophile ko sirf meta position par bheje, use meta director kehte hain. Aise groups zyada tar electron-withdrawing (electrons apni taraf kheenchne wale) hote hain aur arenium intermediate ko kam stable kar dete hain. Yeh zyada tar “meta” (1,3) product dete hain.

Is case mein major (bara) product meta substituted hota hai. Meta directors ki misalein: -CN, C=O, -NO₂, -CO₂-. Nitrobenzene mein meta directing group (-NO₂) hai, is liye is ki chlorination meta position par hoti hai aur meta-chloronitrobenzene banta hai.

blocks.alt: Nitrobenzene, arrow ke oopar Cl2 aur neeche AlCl3, se meta-chloronitrobenzene, Cl NO2 ke meta carbon par.
blocks.caption: Nitrobenzene ki chlorination (kitab ke PDF page 69 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Halogens: khaas case
blocks.text: Halogens (-Cl, -Br) khaas case hain: yeh ring ko benzene se thora kam reactive banate hain, phir bhi naye group ko ortho aur para positions par bhejte hain. Yeh baat Quick Checks 20.7 aur 20.8 mein kaam aayegi.

blocks.prompt: a) Phenol ki nitration benzene se milder (narm) conditions mein kyun ho jati hai?
blocks.explanation: OH group ka oxygen apna lone pair ring ko deta hai aur ring ko bohat active kar deta hai, is liye room temperature par dilute nitric acid hi kaafi hai.

Pehle benzene ki nitration (conc. HNO₃ + conc. H₂SO₄, taqreeban 50°C se kam) se nitrobenzene banayein; phir Cl₂ aur AlCl₃ (ya FeCl₃) se chlorination karein. NO₂ group chlorine ko meta position par bhejta hai. Agar pehle chlorination karein to nitro group 2 ya 4 par jayega.

blocks.prompt: c) In ki nitration (conc. sulphuric acid + nitric acid) mein zyada kaun sa product banega: benzaldehyde, chlorobenzene, phenol, benzene carboxylic acid?
blocks.explanation:
Benzaldehyde: CHO meta director hai → 3-nitrobenzaldehyde.
C₆H₅CHO + HNO₃ → 3-O₂NC₆H₄CHO + H₂O
Chlorobenzene: Cl ortho-para director hai → 2- aur 4-chloronitrobenzene (zyada tar 4).
C₆H₅Cl + HNO₃ → 2- aur 4-ClC₆H₄NO₂ + H₂O
Phenol: OH ring ko bohat active karta hai; conc. HNO₃ + conc. H₂SO₄ se teeno positions (2, 4, 6) par NO₂ lagta hai → 2,4,6-trinitrophenol (picric acid). (Dilute HNO₃ se 2- aur 4-nitrophenol bante hain.)
C₆H₅OH + 3HNO₃ → C₆H₂(NO₂)₃OH + 3H₂O
Benzene carboxylic acid: COOH meta director hai → 3-nitrobenzoic acid.
C₆H₅COOH + HNO₃ → 3-O₂NC₆H₄COOH + H₂O

items: Ortho-para directors (activating): -R, -OH, -OR, -NR₂, -SH, -SR; yeh ring ko electrons dete hain.
Meta directors (deactivating): -NO₂, -CN, C=O, -CO₂-; yeh electrons kheenchte hain.
